Selection: tools/select_questions.py; scoring merge: tools/merge_verdicts.py; workbook: tools/build_workbook.py.

scripts/run_acceptance_test.py hard-codes the REV02 300-question workbook, so it could not take this bank without editing it. The benchmark instead POSTs each question verbatim to the application's own /api/ask endpoint ({"question": ...}, every control at its default), the stateless path the UI serves; no application file was changed.

Input Tokens = prompt tokens of the one answer-generation call per question (length of the tokenized chat-templated prompt, as reported by the runtime). Output Tokens = tokens generated by that call, including text that validation later removed or replaced. When the validator withheld an answer (44 questions), the delivered text is a pipeline notice, not model output, but the generation's tokens are still counted. No other generative model call occurs; the bge-small embedder used by the evaluator is not counted. All 100 questions report both counts.

Duration = client-side time.perf_counter() (monotonic) round trip from sending the HTTP request to receiving the complete response, in seconds (3 dp). /api/ask returns after the live evaluation, so Duration includes it (mean 0.27 s) and HTTP/serialization overhead (mean 0.074 s over pipeline time). Component times are the server's own timings_ms/server_timings_ms. Questions ran strictly sequentially; one warm-up question was sent first and excluded from every statistic; no other benchmark or test process was running.
0 execution errors, 0 timeouts (client timeout 1,800 s), 0 retries, 0 skipped. Each question was asked exactly once.

(a) AI-assisted rubric scoring, not SME-signed. (b) 'Generated Answer' is the delivered answer exactly as returned; for 44 questions that is the validator's withholding notice. (c) 22 selected questions cite the FD&C Act in their key (20 rely on the statute, or on Parts 700-740 generally, with no specific CFR section; COS-710.2-Q1 and UC-COS-006 cite both), and the corpus has no statute text. (d) ISO concordance not scored (all selected rows '—'). (e) openpyxl came from the local uv cache and formulas were verified with pycel (no LibreOffice installed); the workbook is set to recalculate fully on open.
